root_cause_cross_cutting.finding: All four SEC-conditioned proposals (A4-H1, A4-H2, A5-H1, A6-H1) share one fatal, measured infeasibility: the canonical bridge is single-vintage BY DESIGN (one effective date per sector per call = the newest fiscal period end with a gated record), so a sector's observation is pinned to the newest-vintage cohort, which is typically 1-15 filers sharing an off-cycle period end. The declared per-observation coverage floors (0.60, or 0.40 per leg) fail at 60-100% of sector-ticks, the proposals' 'cross-section never empties / >= 9 eligible at every tick' claims are falsified, and A4-H1's additional 100-day endpoint-vintage coherence gate is structurally unsatisfiable at a 252-session differencing lag (vintages advance ~91-366 days per year).

evidence.census_vs_coverage_distinction: census 'fundable' = filer has ANY pre-S0 record (recomputed, matches packet exactly); it does NOT measure newest-vintage cohort size, which is what the floors bind on

overlay_computability.declared: c_t = min(1, 0.10/sigma_book_ann(t)); sigma_book_ann = sqrt(252*mean(r_book(u)^2, u in t-62..t)) on the UNSCALED anchor book; banded DOWN floor(10c)/10; recomputed only at slots; gross = c <= 1.0
overlay_computability.detail: the unscaled book's weights between slots are a deterministic function of the rank series (measured); its daily returns over t-62..t are therefore computable from the same adjusted closes (no external data; NOT computed here - no PnL)
overlay_computability.first_slot_convention_pin_required: at the first S0 slot the book has no prior return history under a force-flat-before-S0 reading: sigma_book = 0 -> 0.10/0 = +inf (IEEE) -> c = 1.0; alternatively a pre-S0 paper-book convention (data available to 2010-01-04) also resolves it; either is computable but the implementation MUST pin one ex ante
overlay_computability.banded_down_only: floor(10*c)/10 is well-defined; c can rise across slots only via full 0.10 band steps (rounding direction is always down)
overlay_computability.c_zero_reachability: c_t = 0 requires sigma_book_ann >= 200% and the effective c floor 0.1 requires >= 100% annualized book vol - unreachable for a gross-1.0 sector spread book (constituent vols measured 16-25% ann, spread-book vol is a fraction of that); the declared c=0 'legitimate flat state' is theoretically open but practically moot, so the min-positions invariant tension is theoretical only
